entries.zh: 强梁：恃强凌弱，以强力逼迫无力反抗的人
entries.en: to coerce by main force; to bully and force one who cannot resist
entries.notes: R 栏空；义依 H「强梁」与 L「forçar al que no puede」互推。

entries.zh: 强使上去；硬逼人上（高处、上位）
entries.en: to force someone to go up; to compel upward
entries.notes: L「a medir」（丈量）与 H「强上」不合，疑原稿本作 subir（上）；M 一处 T99 污损。

entries.en: to coerce by intimidation; to force with harsh severity

entries.zh: 棍棒；打斗、威吓所用的木棍
entries.en: a cudgel; a club or stick used for beating
entries.notes: L「Forcejas」为 forcejar（挣扎、角力）之形，与 H「棍」不完全对应，义依 H/M。

entries.zh: 磨蹭推托、装样不干活；借故推诿
entries.en: to dawdle and make a show of effort so as to avoid work; to shirk
entries.notes: L 末尾残、「棍椿」疑字未定，义依 L「por no hacer」与 M 推求。

entries.zh: 棍棒来往；持棍互殴、你打过来我打过去
entries.en: to trade blows with cudgels; to beat back and forth with a stick
entries.notes: L 后半讹误难读，义依 H「棍来棍去」与 M 逐字对应。
L 栏严重讹误不可读、R 空，仅依 H「尚」与 M 定副词义。

entries.en: to fornicate; to commit illicit intercourse
entries.notes: M 栏记音重叠难辨，义依 L/H。

entries.zh: 嫖；狎妓（原字「缥」为「嫖」之借字）
entries.en: to visit prostitutes; to fornicate with a whore
entries.notes: H「缥」当为「嫖」借字，与次条「嫖」及 M「Pió」互证；M 后半残。

entries.en: to go whoring; to fornicate with prostitutes
entries.notes: M 后半疑混入西语并残损，义依 H/L。

entries.zh: （男子在下的）交合；女上男下之性交
entries.en: to fornicate with the man underneath (woman above)
entries.notes: H 仅「阳」一字，与 L 所述体位之对应未明。

entries.en: to fornicate with the woman on top
entries.notes: H 有「阴/伦」之疑；L 所述体位与上条同指一事。
H 末二字疑（芋/苛）、M「feñgsû̃」未详、R 空。

entries.en: an adulterer; a man guilty of fornication
entries.notes: L 为动词而 H 为名词「奸夫」，义依 H。

entries.zh: 奸淫之事（原字作「芋事」，疑有讹误）
entries.en: an illicit sexual affair (reading of the Chinese head doubtful)
entries.notes: H 疑字、M 一处 T99 污损、R 空，未能定夺。

entries.zh: 嫖到极点；纵欲宿娼至极
entries.en: to whore to the utmost; to fornicate excessively
entries.notes: 「缥」为「嫖」借字，与「到极」合读；M 一处 T99 在「到」上。

entries.zh: 交感：男女相感而合、交合
entries.en: sexual union; intercourse of mutual desire
entries.notes: L「a sposamentos」费解，疑指婚配（esposamientos）之交；义依 H「交感」。

entries.zh: 通奸；男女双方情愿私通
entries.en: to commit adultery by mutual consent

entries.zh: 妇人主动求奸、招引男子私通
entries.en: a woman soliciting fornication with a man
entries.notes: L 语序含混、M 两读且含 T99、R 空，义存疑。
